subject: Failure of spatio-temporal modeling based on zero flated poisson0

messages.author: 9d60de17f7784f72
messages.subject: Failure of spatio-temporal modeling based on zero flated poisson0
parts:
I have built a spatio-temporal model. When it obeys a poisson distribution, the model works fine. But my data has 21% zeros in it, so I chose to obey a zero flated poisson0 distribution, but the modeling fails.

formula<-cases~1+scale(humidity)+f(area,model="bym",graph = g,scale.model = T)+
  f(time,model="rw1",scale.model = T)+
  f(time1,model="iid")+
  f(area1,model="besag",graph=home,
    group=time2,scale.model = T,
    control.group = list(model="rw1"))
model<-inla(formula = formula,data = mydata,
             family = "zeroinflatedpoisson0", E = E,verbose = T,
             control.compute = list(dic=T,cpo=T,waic=T),
             control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE,link=1))
